settings.heading: Settings for grown-ups
settings.saved_offline: Saved on this device. It will sync when you are back online.
settings.scene_note: Plain is calmest. Pictures never move and stay faint behind the cards.
settings.coloured_note: Harder: "Touch the red square" needs colour and shape at once. Best after Lesson 5. Takes effect when Lesson 1 is next opened.
settings.guide_note: Turn off for a plainer screen. This is remembered on this device only.
settings.safe_note: Keeps flashing and big colour changes off. Leave this on unless you know it is safe for this child.
settings.language_note: Changes the words on screen and the spoken prompts. Remembered on this device only.
